exposure: different manual segmentation methods of placenta MR images (2D ROIs and 3D VOIs on placental tissue, retroplacental myometrium, cervix, placenta with underneath myometrium, placenta with underneath myometrium and cervix)
cohort: 64 patients with placenta previa (PP) who underwent MRI examination for suspicion of Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS).
finding: The 3D volume of interest (VOI) segmentation method covering the retroplacental myometrium demonstrated the best performance in predicting Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) using machine learning radiomics.
